title: Modular Reserved-GPU Bands with Predictive Autoscale and SLA Flexibility
creator: Sofia Lin
description: Run a multi-variant experiment to introduce modular reserved GPU bands (small/medium/large) that can be combined, plus predictive autoscale credits and tiered SLA options. Goal is to increase committed ARR while preserving per-token economics and lowering churn risk for enterprise customers who need predictable throughput but occasional burst capacity. The design is intentionally modular so sales can compose offerings for different enterprise sizes and use cases.
acceptance_criteria: Define 3 reserved bands with clear throughput guarantees and price-per-GPU metrics
Design predictive autoscale credit model (monthly credit pool + burst overage pricing) and implement billing triggers
Offer three SLA tiers mapped to reservation+credits combos and document SLO targets and incident response commitments
Console UI prototype for composing bands, viewing credit balance, and configuring autoscale policies
Experiment rollout plan: pilot with 3 existing customers from sales, measure commit uptake and churn impact over 12 weeks
success_metrics: Committed ARR uplift from pilot accounts compared to baseline: target +15%
Conversion rate of pilot customers to annual reserved contracts: target >= 60%
Average cost-per-token delta vs. Hosted: within 10% for majority of pilot workloads
Customer satisfaction (NPS/CSAT) for provisioning and transparency flows: target >= 8/10
Incidence of overage disputes: target < 5% of pilot customers
